body.name: cross-fitted saturated-cell one-step construction
body.construction:
For validation fold \(I_s\), set \(\widehat\pi_k^{(-s)}=\operatorname{clip}_{[\epsilon/2,1-\epsilon/2]}\{\sum_{j
otin I_s}A_j\mathbf1(X_j=k)/(\sum_{j
otin I_s}\mathbf1(X_j=k)\vee1)\}\) and \(\widehat\mu_{ak}^{(-s)}=\sum_{j
otin I_s}Y_j\mathbf1(X_j=k,A_j=a)/(\sum_{j
otin I_s}\mathbf1(X_j=k,A_j=a)\vee1)\); for \(i\in I_s\), let \(\widehat\psi_i=\widehat\mu_{1X_i}^{(-s)}-\widehat\mu_{0X_i}^{(-s)}+A_i(Y_i-\widehat\mu_{1X_i}^{(-s)})/\widehat\pi_{X_i}^{(-s)}-(1-A_i)(Y_i-\widehat\mu_{0X_i}^{(-s)})/(1-\widehat\pi_{X_i}^{(-s)})\); define \(\widehat	au^{\mathrm{OS}}=n^{-1}\sum_i\widehat\psi_i\) and \(\widehat V^{\mathrm{OS}}=n^{-1}\sum_i(\widehat\psi_i-\widehat	au^{\mathrm{OS}})^2\).
